findings.evidence: Both promoted records quote inverted STAC bbox [-180,90,180,-90]. The PC producer description says flood maps cover hydrodynamically connected coastal areas and include global DEM-derived maps plus historical storms, not general inland flooding. The water-availability collection models 3,236 reservoirs; ERA5 forcing is global, CHIRPS is ±50° latitude and EOBS/NLDAS/BOM are regional. Current canonical spatial_coverage only says global flood-depth / water-availability product and repeats the invalid bbox.
findings.fix: Keep the products if desired as global thematic families, but explicitly state coastal flood-only and selected-reservoir coverage, list the regional/latitude-limited forcing components, and label the bbox invalid provider metadata rather than treating it as spatial proof. Use the already captured producer descriptions; no asset validation is needed.

findings.evidence: The PC terraclimate source is marked related_product after remapping it from the existing terraclim scenario record to the baseline target. The PC ms-buildings source is marked component after remapping from the Australia-only existing record to the worldwide target. These relationships were meaningful relative to the old counterpart, not the new canonical target.
findings.fix: Set explicit mapping.relationship for PC terraclimate to related_release or same_family (preserving 1958–2021 edition limits) and PC ms-buildings to exact_dataset or same_family. Keep related_record_ids for terraclim and msbuildings as distinct-scope links.

findings.evidence: PC ms-buildings also carries inverted STAC bbox [-180,90,180,-90], but the captured collection description independently states worldwide releases and the canonical record qualifies country/imagery gaps.
findings.fix: Mark the bbox as invalid provider metadata in the record; retain the documented worldwide thematic scope and coverage caveat.
